'''Trainer''' was a muscular [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was alive<ref name="Jedi" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="5-Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Trainer had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], gray [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light colored skin. They carried a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] with a blue blade and a [[Bryar pistol/Legends|Bryar pistol]]. They would use their lightsaber to trim their facial hair. Trainer wore a black [[Clothing/Legends|sleeveless shirt]] with a red stripe that went down the right side of it. They also wore a pair of matching pants that continued the stripe, and they wore a gray [[Pauldron/Legends|shoulder pad]].<ref name="Jedi" />

==Behind the scenes==
Trainer's only appearance was in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]]<ref name="Jedi" /> released on [[September 30]], [[1997]].<ref name="GS-Date">{{GameSpot|url=reviews/jedi-knight-dark-forces-ii-review/1900-2535572|text=Star Wars Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II Review|author=Dulin, Ron|date=1997-10-09}}</ref> They only appeared in the game's multiplayer portion as a playable character model. As a default, characters had both a lightsaber and Bryar pistol as their starting weapons, with the default lightsaber color being blue. As such, this article assumes that Trainer owned both items.<ref name="Jedi" />
